verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is API-first: cards and cardholders are created through API calls, and disputes and funding have API equivalents to the Dashboard, so it can be driven entirely without a UI. An official Stripe CLI and test-mode purchase simulation support scripted, non-interactive automation, and a community comment independently describes it as API-first. Missing for 10: no documentation of CI-specific usage (pipeline examples, non-interactive CLI auth or test-mode setup in CI), and no hands-on report of running it in CI.
